text:
marta: Heads-up — saw a cluster-wide ECC spike on gpool-us-west-2 around 08:02. 12 unique XIDs over 6 nodes in 8m. Hitting preempt thresholds.

jay: seeing it too. nodes: gpu-node-417, 421, 430. metrics show rx spikes then drop. Could be thermal or driver flake.

sasha: is this the same pattern as last month? last month we soft-cordoned and re-ran memtest, recall one returned clean then failed after 2 days.

marta: yes similar but rate higher. I'm thinking we should try the new "burst-classifier" ML hook to avoid wide drains — classify burst vs persistent. propose: soft-cordon + staged eviction for nodes classified as persistent, otherwise place num-retries and continue kv-cache.

ken: +1. Need rollout plan. If classifier false negative we risk serving GPU failure. How do we measure fp/fn?

marta: classifier uses sliding 10min window + spectral features. Pilot on 3 nodes of gpool-us-west-2-only. Config snippet:

```yaml
gpu_health:
  classifier: ecc_burst_v1
  window_sec: 600
  min_events: 5
  action_on_persistent: cordon-and-evict
  action_on_burst: soft-cordon + notify
  rollout_nodes: ["gpu-node-430","gpu-node-435","gpu-node-441"]
```

lia: need integration with Slurm drain script — when cordon-and-evict triggered, run `/usr/local/bin/slurm-evacuate --grace 300` and set node state DRAIN for k8s.

infra-bot: alert: scheduled test run queued for 1965432200 — will run burst-classifier on 3 nodes in 10m.

jay: Also add cost guard: if cascade would remove >15% GPUs in region, fallback to isolated retry window and page oncall.

marta: agree. add policy: if predicted capacity loss > 12% abort and fallback to rolling rollback.

oncall-bot: @oncall rotation paged: infra-oncall@redwood.com — policy will page if 3+ nodes evicted in 5m

sasha: what's the telemetry overhead? classifier realtime? cpu overhead ok?

marta: model runs on telemetry workers, ~2% CPU per node. logs to health-indexer. We need retention 7d for new signals.

ken: can we simulate with a replay? would like a "replay mode" that feeds last 30d events to evaluate FP/FN.

marta: infra-bot, can we produce a replay bundle for gpool-us-west-2 last 30d?

infra-bot: replay bundle created: s3://redwood-health-replay/gpool-us-west-2/bundle-196543.zip

lia: I'll wire the slurm-evacuate wrapper and add a canary flag to deploy to staging.

jay: plan: deploy classifier in staging -> run replay -> small canary on 3 nodes -> monitor false positives -> enable region-level guard rails -> full rollout.

sasha: timeline?

marta: staging replay + metrics by EOD, canary tomorrow morning, region rollout after 48h stable.

ken: +1. Also document rollback: immediate `infractl node uncordon --force` plus cancel slurm drains.

marta: I'll open a runbook PR and drop links here.

marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/318 — add classifier config + rollback steps

lia: :thumbsup:
